note: Preliminary Clean & Safe methodology: 2 persons per tent, 2 per vehicle. No tent/vehicle breakdown was published, so no adjustment can be reconstructed for these months.
Clean & Safe adopted the Regional Task Force on the Homeless (RTFH) methodology on 2017-04-27.
RTFH raised the vehicle multiplier to 2.03; tent multiplier unchanged. Implemented by Clean & Safe on 2018-05-31.

RTFH stopped applying tent/vehicle multipliers in January 2020; Clean & Safe continued. Multiplier values are UNCHANGED from MAY2018 - this period marks a divergence in practice, not a change in factors.
